title: Best robot lawn mower deal: Save 30% on the Ecovacs Goat A2000 LiDAR Pro Robot Lawn Mower
excerpt: It's too hot outside to mow the grass, so let a robot do it instead.
content_html:
SAVE $600.99: As of Sep. 2, get the Ecovacs Goat A2000 LiDAR Pro robot lawn mower for $1,399 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $1,999.99. That's a discount of 30%.

Credit: Amazon

$1,399 at Amazon
$1,999.99 Save $600.99

Fall may be here, but that isn't stopping high temperatures from putting a damper on our outdoor fun. It's still sticky and sweaty outside for many, and mowing the grass doesn't sound like a great idea. You don't have to deal with it yourself. In fact, you can get a robot lawn mower to handle the job for you in this day and age, and you totally should. Today, you can snatch up a great model on Amazon for an even better price.

As of Sep. 2, get the Ecovacs Goat A2000 LiDAR Pro robot lawn mower for $1,399 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $1,999.99. That's $600.99 off and a discount of 30%.

Mashable Trend Report

This robot lawn mower can handle lawns up to 0.5 acres, and it can navigate all on its own. It uses dual LiDAR to map out your yard as well as AIVI 3D obstacle avoidance so it doesn't run into fencing or other items in your yard. That means you don't have to manually map things out and help it avoid any fenced areas, trees, or rocks that may be in the way.

In addition to navigational help, it has its own built-in edge trimmers and options to set your cutting length. Then, once your lawn mower has completed a cycle in your yard, it'll need to recharge. It can do so in under an hour at 50 minutes. That means you won't be left waiting for it to juice back up, and it can handle a backyard after the front yard.

If you're ready to ditch the to-do list task of mowing your yard, it's high time you went ahead and invested in a robot to hire for the job. Now's a good time to do so with this discount.
